name: Thistlenettle's Badge
summary: Foreman Thistlenettle's badge is all that remains after the collapse in the Deadmines.

sections.title: The Explorers' League in the Deadmines
sections.body: Before the Defias Brotherhood sealed Moonbrook and the tunnels beneath it, dwarven prospectors from Ironforge's Explorers' League worked the old gold mines of Westfall. Foreman Thistlenettle and his crew were deep underground when a tunnel collapsed and split them apart. His brother Wilder escaped to Stormwind City, but the foreman and several laborers were left trapped below.

sections.title: A Grim Confirmation
sections.body: Foreman Thistlenettle died in the unsealed tunnels and rose as mindless undead among the collapsed shafts outside the main foundry. His Explorers' League Badge remained with him. Recovered and brought to his grieving brother, it proves the foreman's death.

faq.q: Who does this badge belong to?
faq.answer: The badge belonged to Foreman Thistlenettle, a dwarven miner and member of the Explorers' League. A sudden tunnel collapse trapped him deep underground beneath Westfall.
Foreman Thistlenettle carries the badge in the monster-infested upper corridors of the Deadmines, outside the main entrance to the Defias stronghold.
Wilder Thistlenettle wants the badge. He is the foreman's brother and lives in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, awaiting word of his kin's fate.

faq.q: Why were the Thistlenettle brothers in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: The brothers surveyed and prospected the mineral-rich caverns beneath Moonbrook for the Explorers' League. Hostile thieves and tunnel collapses ruined their expedition.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Foreman Thistlenettle carried the Explorers' League badge into Westfall. Recovering it keeps a fallen son of Ironforge from being forgotten.
As an Alliance member, you can bring closure to a grieving dwarf in Stormwind's Dwarven District.
